methodology.source: official Bybit completed 4h candles and causally aligned open interest for 24 longitudinal holdout assets

event_policy.sampling: one globally aligned, non-overlapping market decision per forecast horizon

methodology.selection: model family is selected on 2024 only; 2025-2026 is read once as the final split
methodology.dependence_control: the unit of evidence is a globally aligned market episode, not a correlated per-asset signal
